Extracts heading hierarchy (h1-h6) from HTML page

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(null)
    val url = "https://example.com"
    val result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
    println(result.statusCode)
    println(result.metadata.headings?.first()?.level)
    println(result.metadata.headings?.first()?.text)
    println(result.metadata.headings?.size)
}
```
